# Poetry Collection

## The Silent Garden

In the garden where no one goes,
Where shadows dance and silence flows,
The roses bloom in crimson red,
Above the graves of words unsaid.

The fountain weeps its ancient song,
A melody both sad and strong,
While marble statues watch and wait,
For visitors who come too late.

## Midnight Thoughts

The clock strikes twelve upon the wall,
I hear the echo through the hall,
My thoughts like ghosts begin to roam,
Through corridors that feel like home.

The moon looks down with silver eye,
And asks me questions I can't reply,
About the roads I did not take,
And dreams I left for others' sake.

## The Sea's Lament

Oh, restless sea, forever bound,
To crash upon the rocky ground,
You speak in tongues of ancient pain,
Of sailors lost in wind and rain.

Your waves like hands reach toward the shore,
Seeking something evermore,
A peace that lies beyond the tide,
Where all your secrets safely hide.
